tags.name: Buntzen Lake
tags.note: Buntzen Lake, officially adopted 3 June 1905, was formerly called Trout Lake or “Lake Beautiful.” Renamed for Johannes Buntzen, managing director of the Vancouver Power Company and BCER. Site of BCER tunnel connecting Buntzen and Coquitlam Lakes, complete
